message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges. Facts: Wang Mou defrauded victim by false promises to buy house, car garage, etc., obtaining 115,000 RMB. That's fraud (诈骗). Also he later filed false report to police claiming victim defrauded him 640,000 RMB, with friend making false testimony, intending to make victim criminally liable. That's false accusation, i.e., 诬告陷害 (false accusation). The list includes "诬告陷害". So charges: 诈骗;诬告陷害.

Check if any other: maybe also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章"? He made false report, but not forging documents. So likely just fraud and false accusation.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗;诬告陷害<eoa>
